name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 22 – Am 19
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 22a. Commends the paramount work done on a daily basis by Ukrainian healthcare services, and in particular Ukrainian nurses, throughout the war; highlights, against this background, the important work done by the Ukrainian medical movement ‘Be Like We Are’, a grassroots movement made up mostly of nurses, in supporting healthcare workers and defending their rights;
